ideas.pitch: A zero-latency modular web application builder designed specifically for rapid prototyping and deployment under strict 12-hour offline hackathon constraints.
ideas.problem_statement: Cliffesto ’26 Hackathon is a 12-hour offline web development hackathon where participants will work in teams to build a fully functional website based on a problem statement provided at the beginning of the event.
ideas.title: Cliffesto Rapid Web Configurator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Functionality accounts for 40% of the judging criteria; judges will heavily favor a fully deployed, completely bug-free web app over overly complex half-finished features.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative problem-solving and ideation dashboard engineered to work seamlessly in offline campus environments with instant local-first state synchronization.
ideas.problem_statement: Cliffesto ’26 Hackathon is a 12-hour offline web development hackathon where participants will work in teams to build a fully functional website based on a problem statement provided at the beginning of the event.
ideas.title: CliffSync Offline-First Realtime Board
ideas.why_it_could_win: Offline environments often suffer from unstable network conditions; building a reliable local-first web app guarantees smooth live demonstrations to judges without internet anxiety.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined web portal enabling teams to cleanly package their code repositories, live deployment links, and embedded final presentation slides into a single evaluator view.
ideas.problem_statement: Submission Requirements: Each team must submit: Project code Deployment link, if applicable Final presentation
ideas.title: CliffEval Live Judging & Submission Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the explicit submission requirements of the event, making it extremely easy for judges to navigate and verify all deliverables instantly.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web-based presentation and prototype viewer designed for time-bound 12-hour challenges to pitch solutions smoothly during the preliminary rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams qualifying through the Preliminary Round will present their solutions to the judges in their respective time slots on the following day.
ideas.title: CliffRoute Dynamic Presentation Flow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presentation skills are explicitly highlighted in the event description; a polished web-native slide deck and live app combo will stand out among traditional static PDF pitches.

ideas.pitch: An instant project-scaffolding web tool that helps teams rapidly initialize their chosen tech stack and meet code-structure requirements within minutes of the problem drop.
ideas.problem_statement: The problem statement will be disclosed at the start of the hackathon. Teams are required to develop a solution that follows the requirements and constraints specified in the problem statement.
ideas.title: CliffFlow Modular Code Boilerplate Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solving the cold-start problem in a strict 12-hour window saves crucial development hours, ensuring high marks in functionality and completeness.
